name: mkdir
longDesc: Create the DIRECTORY(ies), if they do not already exist.

flags.description: Create parent directories as needed, no error if existing

name: touch
shortDesc: Change file timestamps / Create empty files
longDesc: Update the access and modification times of each FILE to the current time. A FILE argument that does not exist is created empty.

examples.description: Creates an empty file named config.txt

name: cat
shortDesc: Concatenate files and print on the standard output
longDesc: Reads data from files and outputs their contents. Often used to quickly view the contents of short text files.
